Spend the middle of the day on the sand: swim, walk the shore or go for a horseback ride, and enjoy a typical Dominican lunch with fresh lobster. In the afternoon the catamaran sails to Cayo Levantado for a Coco Loco and a last swim before the ride back.
About 12 hours with round-trip A/C hotel transport. Adults $169, kids 3–10 $99, free cancellation up to 24 hours before.

h1: Scuba Doo Punta Cana – Underwater Scooter, Snorkel & Glass-Bottom Boat
intro: Breathe normally, glide under the sea and meet the reef up close, with no diving certification and no swimming skills needed. Scuba Doo Punta Cana puts you on an underwater scooter a few meters below the surface, with a guide right beside you.

A boat takes your group out to the reef. After a short safety briefing you sit on the scooter, put on the air system (no mask and no tube to manage) and cruise through tropical fish and coral at about 3 to 5 meters deep for roughly 20 minutes. Then you can snorkel with a life vest, and the day finishes on a glass-bottom boat looking down at the reef through the floor.

It's one of the easiest ways to see the Caribbean underwater, perfect for first-timers, couples, families with kids from age 8, and anyone who loves the sea but doesn't want to dive. Adults (13+) $65, kids 8–12 $30. Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Honest note: depth, visibility and the exact route depend on the sea that day, and the crew may adjust the stops for your safety. We'd rather tell you now than surprise you.
